blocks.text: PAGADIAN CITY – With a prolonged Super El Niño expected to scorch agricultural lands and alter marine ecosystems through mid-2027, authorities have readied mitigating measures, including acquiring large water tanks for farmers and the local populace. Mayor Samuel Co convened a high-level coordination meeting with the Department of the Interior and Local Government (DILG), Office of Civil Defense (OCD), Bureau of Fire Protection (BFP), City Disaster Risk Reduction and Management Office (CDRRMO), and all 54 barangay captains for a unified defense strategy against the looming severe drought.
